<function name="ResetToDefaultValue" parent="DNumSlider" type="panelfunc">
	<description>
Resets the slider to the default value, if one was set by <page>DNumSlider:SetDefaultValue</page>.

This function is called by the <page>DNumSlider</page> when user middle mouse clicks on the draggable knob of the slider.
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
</function>
